title: Sharpe ratio standard error and minimum track record
prompt: A strategy has T=60 monthly excess returns with sample mean 0.90% and sample standard deviation 3.20% (monthly, simple returns, excess of cash). Assume iid normal returns and use the standard error of the monthly Sharpe ratio SR_m is sqrt((1+SR_m^2/2)/T). Report (1) the annualised Sharpe ratio (multiply the monthly Sharpe by sqrt(12)), (2) the annualised standard error of that Sharpe ratio, (3) the plug-in Wald statistic SR_m divided by this standard error (called t here; unitless and identical at any horizon), and (4) the minimum integer number of months with the same monthly mean and standard deviation needed for this statistic to reach 1.96 (round up).

inputs.annualisation: sqrt(12) for Sharpe and its standard error

outputs.name: se_sharpe_annual
outputs.description: annualised standard error of the Sharpe

outputs.name: min_months
outputs.description: minimum integer months so that t >= 1.96
